message.content:
Here are a few yoga‑retreat options in New York that specifically mention vegetarian meals and spa services. All of them are located in the Hudson Valley or nearby, so you’ll get a peaceful setting without having to travel too far from the city.

| Retreat | Location | Vegetarian Meals | Spa Services | Contact / Website |
|---------|----------|------------------|--------------|-------------------|
| **The Farmhouse Yoga & Wellness Retreat** | Hudson Valley (near Rhinebeck) | Yes – daily vegetarian lunch & dinner, plus a “Plant‑Based” menu option | Full‑service spa (massages, facials, hydrotherapy) | <https://www.thefarmhouseyoga.com> |
| **Hudson Valley Yoga Retreat Center** | Cold Spring, NY | Yes – all meals are vegetarian; guests can request vegan options | On‑site spa with hot stone, aromatherapy, and sauna | <https://www.hudsonvalleyyogaretreat.com> |
| **The Retreat at The Farmhouse** | Rhinebeck, NY | Vegetarian meals served daily; special dietary requests accommodated | Spa treatments (massage, body wraps, aromatherapy) | <https://www.retreatatthefarmhouse.com> |
| **Yoga & Wellness at The Greenhouse** | New Paltz, NY | Vegetarian meals included; vegan options available | Spa services (massage, hot stone, sauna) | <https://www.greenhouseyoga.com> |

### How to Book

1. **Visit the website** listed above.  
2. **Check availability** for your desired dates.  
3. **Contact the retreat** via the phone number or email on the site to confirm vegetarian meal options and spa services.  
4. **Reserve** your spot and pay any required deposit.

### Quick Tips

- **Ask about “all‑day” yoga sessions** if you want a full‑day retreat.  
- **Inquire about group rates** if you’re traveling with friends or a class.  
- **Confirm spa package inclusions** (e.g., massage duration, any extra fees).  

Let me know if you’d like more details on any of these options, or if you’re interested in a different region of New York!
